equation_number_metadata_contract.principle: Equation numbers are structural metadata attachments, not geometric expression contents.
equation_number_metadata_contract.whitespace_gap_mechanism: Typeset display equations place equation numbers at the column margin. In ViLT Page 4, the blank whitespace gap between mathematical formula and equation number ranges from 76.3 pt (Eq 1) to 129.3 pt (Eq 6). A single continuous bounding box encompassing both expression and equation number forces up to 129 pt of blank whitespace into the gold target, mathematically capping the maximum achievable IoU of a tight expression detector to between 0.35 and 0.55.
equation_number_metadata_contract.spurious_feature_finding: In VILT-001, the feature check 'has_equation_number_1' passed because the string '1' appeared in subscript t_1 T, not because the right-margin equation number '(1)' was part of the proposal body. In VILT-002, no numeral '2' existed in the formula, correctly exposing that '(2)' was not within proposal L4_line_072.

dual_bounding_box_specification.math_expression_bbox: Tightly bounds the mathematical expression tokens excluding right-margin blank whitespace and equation number.
dual_bounding_box_specification.equation_number_bbox: Tightly bounds the equation label/number at the margin.
dual_bounding_box_specification.full_row_bbox: Spans the full line width including whitespace and equation number (legacy compatibility).

architectural_recommendations.title: Adaptive Subscript/Superscript Baseline Grouping
architectural_recommendations.description: Replace rigid 3.0 pt centre-y tolerance with font-size proportional vertical tolerance: tolerance = max(3.0, 0.45 * max_font_size). For 10pt base text with 7pt scripts, tolerance becomes ~4.5 pt, correctly preserving scripts at Δy = 3.1–3.3 pt without fracturing baseline lines.

architectural_recommendations.title: Decoupled Equation Number Metadata Attachment
architectural_recommendations.description: Adopt dual-bounding-box ground truth: evaluate math expression boundaries against math_expression_bbox, and evaluate equation numbers as associated metadata attributes (has_equation_number, equation_number_bbox) rather than penalizing expression IoU against full-row whitespace boxes.

architectural_recommendations.title: Multiline Association Guardrails
architectural_recommendations.description: Require multiline proposals (Level 5) to verify semantic or structural alignment (e.g., shared relation symbol =, aligned indentation, or explicit punctuation continuations) rather than merging any two vertically adjacent fragments within 16 pt.
